prompt: A warehouse club asks whether its revenue is growing. Which takeaway matters most?

exhibit.title: Members and annual spend per member

options.feedback: True, but spend per member fell 40%, so revenue fell.

options.text: Revenue grew, since members rose faster than spend fell
options.feedback: Members rose 50% (×1.5) but spend fell 40% (×0.6): 1.5 × 0.6 = 0.9, so revenue fell about 10%.

options.text: Revenue fell about 10% despite 50% more members
New members are bargain hunters who spend little
options.feedback: The chart shows the average falling, not who the new members are.

explanation: Revenue = members × spend per member: 100k × $500 = $50M in 2022, 150k × $300 = $45M in 2025, a fall of about 10%.

extras.proof: Revenue = members × spend per member: 100k × $500 = $50M in 2022, 150k × $300 = $45M in 2025, a fall of about 10%.
